# K11 America by Wylco

> Wylco LLC (Miami, Florida) imports and distributes K11 HVAC-R products in the United States: refrigerant micro-leak sealants with integrated UV leak detection, UV dyes and thread/gasket sealants. Sells to HVAC supply houses, wholesalers and contractors.

## Products
- [K11 TapaFugas](https://wylcosolutions.com/products): micro-leak sealant, 10 ml syringe, systems up to 36,000 BTU/h; injected with the system running, no evacuation; tested per ASHRAE Standard 97.
- [K11 TapaFugas 2-in-1](https://wylcosolutions.com/products): polymer-free micro-leak sealant with integrated UV tracer; one injection, system running, no evacuation; tested per ASHRAE Standard 97; for micro-leaks (30+ days to lose charge).
- [K11 Revela Fugas](https://wylcosolutions.com/products): high-fluorescence UV leak detection dye; mineral, POE and PAG oils.
- [K11 Sella Plus](https://wylcosolutions.com/products): sealant and lubricant for flanges, threads, gaskets and O-rings; stays flexible.

## Guides

## How to buy (business buyers only)
- [Order page](https://wylcosolutions.com/order): SKUs, units per case, live stock, terms and order form (server-rendered HTML, no JavaScript needed). Spanish: https://wylcosolutions.com/es/order
- [Live stock (JSON)](https://wylcosolutions.com/api/stock): cases available per SKU, availability InStock/PreOrder, buy_url.
- [Catalog + order API (JSON)](https://wylcosolutions.com/catalog.json): seller, terms, products with live stock, order API fields.
- Pay one case online: if buy_url is not null, open https://wylcosolutions.com/buy/{slug} (Stripe Checkout, choose number of cases, card or ACH). Slugs: tfk11-10, tfk11-co, k11-2in1-11, spk11-b35, 20002, rfk11.
- Order API: POST https://wylcosolutions.com/api/pedido (form-encoded or JSON). Required: company, contact, email, address, city, state, zip, business_type, business=yes, qty_{slug}=cases. A Stripe invoice (card, ACH, wire) is emailed within 1 business day. Send Accept: application/json for a JSON reply with reference number. In-stock cases are reserved immediately; the rest becomes a pre-order.
- Minimum order 1 full case per SKU. Payment: card, ACH, wire, Zelle. Prices in USD at checkout or by quote (not published). Ships from Miami, FL: in stock 2–5 business days after payment.
- Sold to HVAC-R businesses only, not to individuals.
